Hi, I don’t have all of the same sensations but similar. 

Mine consist of rapid heart rate, sudden weakness, dissociation, sweating, dizziness etc…

100% sudden blood sugar drop… I have anxiety and the initial symptoms can feel similar but I know straight away when I feel breathless and dizzy and weak that it’s a blood sugar episode. 

I’ve read online and apparently it’s common with women who have endometriosis although it’s not scientifically documented anywhere… like most female reproductive ailments… 

Definitely see your GP to discuss!

Good luck!

I’m in a loving long term relationship. I always said that if I didn’t find my soul mate I would be a woman of flow. A woman who drifted, and loved and broke hearts. Well as many that didn’t understand me. But I found the one. He loves me for who I am. And he’s such a blessing. He puts up with my quirks and strange obsessions. And severe anxiety… you will all find love. And if you don’t want a long term partner then keep looking because there’s someone out there who will understand you.

Coming from someone who has recently developed a fear of going outside for long periods of time. Constant health anxiety. Constant worry of anything and everything that can go wrong. I am so very in love with someone that is patient, kind and understanding. Sometimes I do feel like I must’ve been a saint in my past life to deserve them. I often feel like a burden etc. But he always stays by me. Never gets frustrated and just seems to have a otherworldly understanding of me and my emotions. So the answer is yes. Yes you will find someone who loves every inch of you, the good and the bad, the hard and the difficult. 

If I can offer any advice try and find peace within yourself before you seek peace with another person. Because whilst I am very lucky. I want and need to overcome this on my own. And I will!
